page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words set inline and in some lines as display entries; running head at top with page number at top right; no margin notes; a Hebrew catchword-like entry "חטר" at the lower right.

main_text.p: חפורת לבא Transfierunt incisiones ipsorū fossam cordis. Sic Ven.& Basilienf. Regia habent: עברו רוטביהון חפו על לוחי לבהון Transfeuntes rugę ipforum, operuerunt tabulas cordis ipforum. Psalterium Nebienfe: עברו חטביהון רחפת לבא Transfierút incisiones fuę, quę cooperuerunt cor; Unde prius חפורת videtur positum pro חפו ית. Psal.73.3.
חטט Ch.& Syr.Suere,assuere,consuere. Idē quod חוט. Pahel חטט Idem.
מחטא Ch.Acus sartoria: Subula. Exo.21.6. & Deut.15.17.in Jon. Sic Syr. ܡܚܛܐ Matt.19.24. Mar.10.15.
חטם חוטמא Ch. Nasus, Levit.21.18.in Jon.

חטף Ch.& Syr. Rapere, corripere, diripere, praedari, auferre. Deinde Syris quoque est, Antevertere, praevertere, praevenire, Act.18.27. Pahel Particip. ܡܚܛܦܢ Rapiunt, Matth.11.12. Ithpah. אתחטף, Syr. ܐܬܚܛܦ Rapi, Abripi.
חטופא, חטוף Ch. ܚܛܘܦܐ Syr.Vis, violentia, injuria, rapina, direptio. Plur. חטופין, emph. חטופיא.
חטוף ܚܛܘܦܐ Syr.Raptor, rapax.Plur. חטופין Obad.5.
מחטפין Ch. Strigiles. Esth.6.11.in Targ. sec.
חטפיתא Ch. Nomen avis rapacis, Hebr. תחמס, Lev.11.16. in Targ.Jonath.
